scope: Compiled product termination during active printing on two simulated MCU PTYs
checks: Both stop callbacks completed before dependency release
Restart persisted cancelled record and idle state
New MCU session receives no replayed motion
additionalTest: host/acceptance/product-host-journey.test.ts: active host abort, reopen disk journal, preserve previous completed job
limitations: Single timing observation per signal, not a statistical performance benchmark
MCU stop policies are simulated callbacks; no physical stop acceptance
SIGKILL and power loss not covered
No Python retired; default printer entrypoint remains Python
Historical Node crash and numerical failures remain unresolved
